NEW LISTING IN PAONIA — AND THIS ONE IS FULL OF CHARM! ✨

📍 708 3rd Street | Paonia, Colorado
💲 365,000

If you’ve been waiting for an adorable home in the heart of Paonia, this may be the one. This inviting 2-bedroom, 1-bath cottage combines character, comfort, and an incredibly convenient location — just one block from Paonia Town Park and close to downtown shops, cafés, and everything that makes Paonia special.

🌿 HOME HIGHLIGHTS:
• 988± sq. ft.
• 0.14± acres
• Sunny front porch
• New windows
• Generously sized bedrooms
• Cozy great room with gas fireplace
• Fenced backyard
• Patio + storage shed
• Mostly furnished
• NO HOA

There’s something about a classic Paonia cottage that just feels like home — and this one is ready for its next chapter. 🤍

✨ Don’t wait to see it in person!
